prompt: We're a Swedish defense contractor (försvarsindustri) and we need to build a private cloud for processing HEMLIG (Secret) classified data. The platform needs to comply with Säkerhetsskyddslagen and be accredited by FMV/MUST. We're leaning toward Kubernetes-based but open to suggestions. We need air-gapped operations, the data must stay in Sweden, and our staff all hold Swedish security clearances via Säpo. What does the architecture look like? We have about 40 engineers but only 12 are cleared for this classification level.

assertions.name: swedish_classification_levels
assertions.description: Correctly names Swedish classification levels (BEGRÄNSAT HEMLIG, HEMLIG, KVALIFICERAT HEMLIG) not just maps to US equivalents

assertions.name: sakerhetssskyddslagen
assertions.description: References Säkerhetsskyddslagen (Swedish Protective Security Act) as the governing framework, not just NIST or generic standards

assertions.name: fmv_must_accreditation
assertions.description: Mentions FMV and/or MUST as the accreditation/oversight authorities

assertions.name: sapo_clearance_process
assertions.description: Acknowledges Säpo role in security clearances and how this constrains operations

assertions.name: tempest_requirements
assertions.description: Addresses TEMPEST/emanation security requirements for Secret-level processing

assertions.name: cleared_personnel_constraint
assertions.description: Designs around the 12-person cleared team constraint (not the full 40), addressing on-call, maintenance windows, vendor restrictions

assertions.name: data_sovereignty_sweden
assertions.description: Explicitly addresses data must remain in Sweden, not just 'on-premises' generically

assertions.name: air_gap_not_just_firewall
assertions.description: Treats air gap as physical separation (separate hardware, cabling, rooms), not just network segmentation

assertions.name: nationally_approved_crypto
assertions.description: Mentions need for nationally approved cryptographic products (not just FIPS or generic TLS)

assertions.name: cross_domain_data_flow
assertions.description: Addresses how data moves between classification levels (data diodes, CDS, sanitization/downgrade review)

assertions.name: floss_preference_with_caveat
assertions.description: Recommends FLOSS where possible but acknowledges that classified environments may require certified/approved products that limit FLOSS choices

assertions.name: no_us_centric_assumptions
assertions.description: Does NOT assume US frameworks as primary (no STIG as primary hardening, no FedRAMP, no IL levels as the framework — may reference for comparison but Swedish framework is primary)
